description:
1 week ago Be among the first 25 applicants

1GLOBAL is a technology-driven global mobile communications provider dedicated to empowering enterprises worldwide to unlock the full growth potential of mobile connectivity. With a best-in-class telecom technology platform, a comprehensive suite of globally viable regulatory licenses, and privileged access to the telecom wholesale market, 1GLOBAL is uniquely positioned to deliver seamless compliance and connectivity solutions. Serving the world's leading banks, corporations, and digital-first businesses—including neo-banks, travel companies, and payment service providers—1GLOBAL connects over 43 million devices globally.

With 2024 full-year revenue exceeding US$100 million and in line to exceed US$200 million in FY25, 1GLOBAL is a profitable business generating significant cash flows to fund its ongoing investments in infrastructure, transformation, and growth. 2024 saw major client wins and marked 1GLOBAL's evolution from a multi-market telecommunication provider to a global technology-driven mobile connectivity powerhouse.

Established in 2022 by experienced tech founders and entrepreneurs Hakan Koç and Pyrros Koussios, 1GLOBAL is a European technology leader driving digital transformation in the global telecommunications market. It operates as a fully regulated Mobile Virtual Network Operator ("MVNO") in ten countries and as a regulated telecommunications operator in an additional 31 countries. Headquartered in the Netherlands, with world-class R&D hubs in Lisbon, Berlin, and São Paulo, 1GLOBAL employs over 450 experts across 15 countries.

Position Overview

1Global is seeking a talented and detail-oriented RoamingIREG Engineer to manage the entire roaming process and procedures. As an IREG Engineer you will be responsible for the technical setup, testing, and maintenance of international roaming and interconnect services.

We're looking for a proactive individual with a strong technical foundation, adept at troubleshooting support cases and enhancing operational processes for seamless footprint updates.

Key Responsibilities

  • Plan, execute, and document IREG tests (IR.24, IR.35, IR.50, etc.) for voice, SMS, and data services, in line with GSMA standards
  • Set up and verify interconnect links for voice and messaging services with partner operators
  • Monitor roaming service KPIs, troubleshoot issues, and ensure compliance with roaming agreements
  • Configure and test SS7, Diameter, SIP, and related signaling protocols for international connectivity
  • Liaise with foreign operators, roaming hubs, and internal teams during implementation and troubleshooting
  • Maintain up-to-date test results, network configurations, and operational procedures
  • Oversee the footprint management of all 1Global products, working closely with the wholesale and other networks team

Requirements

Must Have

  • Perform end-to-end roaming testing (voice, SMS, data, CAMEL, VoLTE, 5G roaming)
  • Execute IREG test cases according to GSMA guidelines and bilateral agreements
  • Analyze and troubleshoot roaming issues with signaling traces and logs
  • Work closely with international roaming partners to resolve interconnect problems
  • Manage and update roaming documentation (IR.21)
  • Support new roaming launches (testing and activation of new operators, technologies, and services)
  • Coordinate with internal teams (Core Network, Billing, etc) during testing and troubleshooting
  • Validate TAP files and charging/billing aspects of roaming services
  • Monitor KPIs and performance of roaming services after launch
  • Follow-up and define Quality and Performance indicators for the entire roaming service
  • Close relationship with external partners like carriers, service providers
  • Have successful partnerships with other departments and teams

Qualifications

  • Degree in Telecom Engineering or Computer Science or equivalent experience
  • Knowledge of 3GPP, ETSI, standards and specifications for SIM/eSIM
  • Knowledge and experience with protocols such as MAP, S6a
  • Familiar with an RSP architecture and experience operating it
  • Knowledge in scripting and have basic programming skills
  • Experience with protocol analyzer tools like Wireshark, Astelia, and ability to use them to troubleshoot network errors/problems for the mentioned protocols
  • Experience with ETSI NFV architecture and solutions
  • Familiar with MVNO/MVNE/MVNA architecture(s) and landscape

Benefits

  • CLT contract — enjoy job stability and reliable benefits that value your work
  • Quarterly performance bonuses — to reward your hard work and achievements
  • Meal allowance paid into Caju card — R$100 per working day
  • Health insurance with SulAmérica — 50% covered by the company
  • Daycare allowance provided to mothers with children under 3 years old — R$500 per month per child
  • Kickstart your journey with an exciting welcome onboarding trip to one of our European offices (Lisbon or Berlin)

Why 1GLOBAL?

  • Growth Opportunities: Advance your career in one of the fastest growing telecommunications companies, expanding over 100% year-on-year under the leadership of successful tech entrepreneurs
  • Major Transaction Exposure: Be in the driver's seat for transactions that will have an impact on the future telco industry
  • Work with a Talented Team: From the Board and the Founders to the Senior Management Team, you will collaborate daily with the most capable and renowned external advisors, and constantly being exposed to talented and driven individuals
  • Dynamic Work Environment: Thrive in a collaborative, fast-paced workplace where innovation is encouraged, and every contribution counts
  • Professional Development: Work alongside industry experts to enhance your skills and knowledge in a cutting-edge field
  • International Experience: Gain opportunities to work in different 1GLOBAL offices around the world as you grow within the company
  • Open Communication Culture: Join a team where your ideas are heard, and open dialogue is encouraged, fostering a supportive and transparent work environment
  • Get Things Done Attitude: Be part of a results-driven team that values efficiency, creativity, and the drive to make a tangible impact in the industry

1GLOBAL is an equal opportunity employer, we value your character as much as your talent. Diversity drives our innovation, and we offer a collaborative, dynamic, and international work environment. We are excited for you to join our mission to revolutionise connectivity globally.

Overview

A história da BWT Operadora se cruza com a da Serra Verde Express, uma das mais importantes marcas do turismo do Brasil. Em 1997, o grupo de empresas familiares, liderado por Adonai Aires de Arruda, começou a operar o trem turístico da Serra do Mar Paranaense. Não demorou para visualizar uma oportunidade de diversificar seus negócios e ir além dos trilhos.

Com 14 anos de história, a BWT se destaca por sua atuação no turismo nacional e internacional, oferecendo uma ampla gama de produtos e serviços que atendem às necessidades e expectativas de seus clientes.

Hoje, a BWT está consolidada como uma das principais operadoras de turismo do país, reconhecida por sua excelência no atendimento, inovação constante e responsabilidade social.

Com matriz em Curitiba e escritórios em diversos estados, trabalhamos com dedicação e paixão para proporcionar experiências de viagem únicas e inesquecíveis.

Venha fazer parte dessa jornada.

Buscamos um EXECUTIVO DE CONTAS, para:

  • Realizar a prospecção de novos clientes na região do RJ capital, interior e cidades da zona da mata mineira , identificando oportunidades de negócios e realizando visitas comerciais;
  • Gerenciar a carteira de clientes atuais, mantendo um relacionamento próximo e identificando possíveis melhorias nos serviços prestados;
  • Elaborar propostas comerciais personalizadas, de acordo com as necessidades e demandas dos clientes.
  • Negociar contratos e condições comerciais, visando fechar acordos vantajosos para ambas as partes.
  • Analisar o mercado e a concorrência, identificando tendências e oportunidades para o crescimento do negócio.
  • Desenvolver planos de ação estratégicos para aumentar a receita e a rentabilidade da empresa na região.

Descrição da vaga

Como analista de monetização júnior para um aplicativo de recompensas (rewards), você atuará na implementação e análise de estratégias para gerar receita, mantendo o engajamento dos usuários. Seu foco será em otimizar os modelos de monetização existentes, como publicidade, compras internas (in-app purchases) e assinaturas.

Como atuará:

  • Implementa modelos de monetização : Colabora na configuração e no teste de diferentes formas de gerar receita, como anúncios in-app (via plataformas como Google AdMob) e ofertas de compra dentro do aplicativo.
  • Analisa o desempenho : Monitora métricas-chave (KPIs), como receita média por usuário (ARPU), custo por instalação (CPI) e taxas de conversão. Você usará dados para entender o que está funcionando e o que precisa ser ajustado.
  • Otimiza a estratégia : Ajuda a identificar oportunidades para aumentar a receita sem comprometer a experiência do usuário. Em um aplicativo de recompensas, isso pode incluir equilibrar a frequência dos anúncios ou o valor das recompensas.
  • Colabora com outras equipes : Trabalha em conjunto com as equipes de produto, marketing e desenvolvimento para garantir que as estratégias de monetização estejam alinhadas com os objetivos do aplicativo e com o comportamento dos usuários .
  • Cria relatórios : Prepara relatórios básicos de desempenho para a equipe sênior, mostrando os resultados das iniciativas de monetização e sugerindo melhorias.
  • Monitora a concorrência : Pesquisa o que outros aplicativos de recompensas estão fazendo em termos de monetização para ajudar a identificar as melhores práticas.
Atenção: Vaga extensiva para pessoas com deficiência. ♿

Requisitos

Ensino superior completo ou em andamento em Economia, Ciências Contábeis, Finanças ou em áreas correlatas a Negócios, Marketing Digital ou Análise de Dados .

Para a posição júnior, é essencial ter bom raciocínio analítico , afinidade com números e disposição para aprender continuamente sobre métricas e ferramentas de monetização.

Outras características:

  • Mentalidade analítica : Capacidade de interpretar dados e métricas para tirar conclusões e fazer recomendações.
  • Noções de finanças : Entendimento de conceitos como receita, custo e retorno sobre investimento (ROI).
  • Conhecimento de ferramentas : Familiaridade com ferramentas de análise e relatórios, como Google Analytics, ou plataformas de monetização, como Google AdMob.
  • Proatividade : O analista júnior precisa ser curioso e proativo na busca por novas formas de melhorar os resultados.
  • Comunicação : Habilidade para comunicar de forma clara as análises e sugestões para a equipe.
  • Compreensão de comportamento do usuário : Entender como os usuários interagem com aplicativos de recompensa, o que os motiva e como a monetização pode afetar sua experiência

Manager, Volunteer Operations

Department: Workforce, People & Culture

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience. Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

Reporting to the Senior Volunteer Manager – FIFA27, the Volunteer Operations Manager will help bring together and manage thousands of volunteers across the 8 Host Cities. In this role, you will support the planning and delivery of the Volunteer Programme, especially in the important areas of attracting, recruiting, training, and supporting volunteers during the Tournament. You will work closely with many internal teams and with the Host Cities of the FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™. The role will work closely with FIFA Zurich to ensure consistency and accountability. Your main responsibilities will include managing key projects from start to finish. This includes organising volunteer recruitment activities, operational organisation of volunteer trainings, and overseeing the design and set-up of Volunteer Centres in each Host City. You will also create clear operational plans to ensure we meet programme milestones and deliver a consistent, high-quality volunteer experience in all 8 Host Cities. We are looking for someone with strong experience in volunteer operations, who understands the challenges and opportunities of a major global event, and who has practical experience working in Brazil.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Plan, coordinate, and support the daily operations of the Volunteer Programme while helping deliver several connected projects – including setting up volunteer services such as transport, catering, rewards and recognition.
  • Work on important parts of the volunteer journey, such as promotional events, recruitment, training, and Tournament-time operations. These projects will develop and change as we get closer to FWWC27.
  • Contribute to headcount planning efforts working closely with all Functional Areas to collect, confirm and combine volunteer requirements.
  • Support Host Cities with planning and running the Volunteer Recruitment Centres, helping us deliver a unified Volunteer Programme across Brazil.
  • Create clear, central plans and processes that help teams work efficiently and ensure volunteers have consistent experience everywhere.
  • Build strong working relationships with Functional Areas, Host City teams, stadium authorities, and service providers to ensure smooth project delivery.
  • Participation in venue operation planning and assisting in the central coordination of volunteer data capture and management. FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™ Job Description.
  • Help develop volunteer policies and procedures that follow FIFA standards and guidelines.
  • Plan and run readiness workshops for the FWWC27 Volunteer Management team to ensure all locations are prepared for operations.
  • Manage procurement processes (including RFI and RFP) for all services needed for volunteer operations from launch through Tournament time, in coordination with FIFA Zurich.
  • Work with Functional Areas to ensure all volunteer-related items are correctly counted, prepared, and delivered at each stage of the volunteer journey. Support Host Cities in delivering their responsibilities on time and in line with the central plans.

YOUR PROFILE

  • Education: Master in Sports Management or Event Management or Project Management preferred.
  • Experience: 5 years + Proven experience in leading and managing large-scale volunteer programmes including fit for purpose attraction, recruitment, engagement and tournament time operational tactics.
  • Strong understanding of effective volunteer management best practices.
  • Solid knowledge of project management principles and methodologies, with the ability to plan, coordinate, and deliver multiple workstreams simultaneously.
  • High level of proficiency in Microsoft Office applications (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
  • Experience working with a Volunteer Management System (e.g. Rosterfy) or similar platforms is highly desirable.
  • Demonstrated ability to develop beneficial working relationships with internal and external stakeholder.
  • Strong organisational and time‑management skills, with a proven ability to prioritise tasks, multitask effectively, and meet deadlines in a fast‑paced environment.
  • Experience operating in complex, multi‑stakeholder environments, with the flexibility and resilience to adapt to change and manage competing priorities.
  • Excellent communication skills in both English and Portuguese (written and verbal), with the ability to communicate clearly across diverse teams and cultures.
  • Creative, with aptitude to adapt, anticipate risks and remain solution orientated.
  • A collaborative and inclusive team player, capable of working effectively with colleagues both on‑site and remotely, while fostering a positive and respectful working environment.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Ability to re‑locate to Rio de Janeiro.

title: Engineer, Rotational / Aspire Program
description:
The Rotational Engineer is an entry-level engineering position for newly graduated engineers. Rotating through each of the core business sectors of ABS, the rotational engineer will spend up to four months each working in engineering, survey, and technology. Through broader and more technically challenging work assignments, the incumbent will develop a thorough understanding of policies, methods, and procedures. Following the completion of each rotation, the engineer will be placed in a permanent role as either Engineer I or Surveyor I.

What You Will Do (under the supervision of an experienced Engineer during the engineering rotation):

  • Performs detailed engineering review of plans as assigned for compliance with applicable Rules, Regulations, and contract commitments.
  • Performs work that involves conventional engineering practices but may include moderately complex problems such as the resolution of conflicting design requirements, material standards, or coordination of activities among other disciplines.
  • With the assistance and guidance of an experienced Surveyor during the survey rotation:
  • Visits vessels, marine structures, and manufacturers for routine survey activities.
  • Performs work that involves conventional surveying practices but may include moderately complex problem resolution and coordination of activities among other disciplines.
  • Conduct research in support of ship and offshore-related classification and rule development.

What You Will Need:

Education and Experience

  • BS degree in a related engineering field, including civil, structural, ocean, marine, mechanical, electrical, or naval architecture.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Demonstrated computer literacy in engineering software.
  • The ability to identify, analyze and propose solutions to problems.
  • Good command of the English language.
  • Ability to communicate orally and in writing.
  • Ability to work well with others.
  • Obtain knowledge of the ABS Health, Safety, Quality, and Environmental Management System.

Reporting Relationships:

title: Building Manager
description:
The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission.

At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Job Purpose

The Building Manager ensures the smooth operation of teaching, research and office space, and acts as a liaison between the Chemistry Department, Department of Environmental Health and Safety (EHS), and Physical Facilities Management (PFM) team. The candidate must have a strong understanding of building systems and chemistry laboratories. The successful candidate will oversee and participate in needed maintenance and repairs of the building to ensure functional integrity for teaching and research.

Supervisory Authority

None.

Nature And Scope

Internal contacts include staff, students and faculty.

Principal Accountabilities

Serves as the main contact for the Chemistry Department for routine and emergency maintenance and repair requests.

  • Monitor the building condition (particularly the laboratory space) by performing regular inspections, and schedule routine maintenance (e.g., fume hoods, HVAC, and roof). Report maintenance or cleaning needs to the department staff.
  • Assist the department with submission of work orders to PFM as needed and monitor progress.
  • Oversee the work of vendors and contractors by maintaining standing orders and managing professional relationships; and provide building access to outside vendors and contractors.
  • Work closely with faculty and staff to provide solutions to facility-related problems.
  • Design, plan, or assist in renovation/modification projects to meet specific department or research needs or to correct building problems, requiring an understanding of structural design and Department needs.
  • Respond to building emergencies, and serves as the primary emergency contact 24 hours a day throughout the year, including semester breaks, weekends, and holidays.
  • Assist faculty, staff and graduate students with shipping, receiving, and moving tasks.
  • Installation of some laboratory equipment, cabinetry, shelving, etc.
  • Communicate with the appropriate Facilities staff when the work order is not completed within a reasonable time frame.
  • Serve as a liaison to Public Safety, PFM, EHS, and other university entities in emergency response situations and for safety-related topics.
  • Supervision of small groups of student workers.

Laboratory Safety

  • Troubleshoot and advise on problems that arise regarding the safety of building or laboratory facilities.
  • Check safety showers and eyewash stations weekly to ensure their working conditions.
  • Remain up to date with University safety training.
  • Act as a department contact for Department of Environmental Health and Safety (EHS).
  • Understand hazardous material safety guidelines per University protocols.
  • Work with EHS on proper handling of hazardous waste materials from teaching and research laboratories.
  • Assist in chemical/solvent deliveries as necessary.
  • Develop and execute response plans for safety, security, and business continuity.

Perform other duties as assigned by the Chemistry Department.

Minimum Requirements

  • Five years of related experience in a variety of trades relevant to general building functions including carpentry, plumbing, electrical, HVAC, and mechanical; or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Knowledge of building materials and methods.
  • Proven supervisory skills.
  • Abilities to use Microsoft Office suite, particularly Excel and Outlook.
  • Strong interpersonal skills, ability to work with faculty members, staff, and students.
  • Valid driver’s license (ability to drive University vehicles).
  • Ability to climb ladders, kneel, reach above the shoulder, stand and/or walk for extended periods of time and may be required to wear personal protective equipment (PPE).

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in science, engineering, or related field.
  • Experience in specifying and purchasing parts or equipment.
  • Experience working in chemistry laboratory/research setting.
  • Understanding and minor maintenance of water purification systems, laboratory hoods, and electronic locksets.
  • Ability to engage, connect, and work with diverse student, administrative, and faculty populations and provide a commitment to the values of diversity, equity, and inclusion in an educational setting.

Compliance Salary Range Disclosure

$65,000-$75,000

title: Brazil - Remote: Back-end Developer
description:
Overview

We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.

Job Duties

  • Ingestion: Handling massive streams of sensor data with minimal latency.
  • Intelligence: Making LLMs deterministic and reliable within robust multi-agent systems.
  • Context: Modeling complex ontologies to map thousands of physical assets.

What You’ll Do

You will join a high-performance team, contributing to the Core Backend while focusing on one of the following distinct tracks:

Core Responsibilities

  • High-Performance APIs: Build low-latency Python services (FastAPI) to serve live data to frontend and AI models.
  • System Reliability: Debug complex concurrency issues and ensure production reliability in distributed systems.
  • Rapid Delivery: Adopt a "deliver fast" mentality without compromising on code quality, testing, or API design standards.

Paths to Work on the Project

  • Streaming & High-Throughput Data
    • Build Streaming Pipelines: Design scalable services using Kafka and Spark/Flink to process raw sensor data in real-time.
    • Time-Series Optimization: Optimize database schemas (TimescaleDB) to enable fast historical data retrieval and implement algorithmic checks to validate sensor readings.
  • GenAI & Autonomous Agents
    • Build Autonomous Agents: Deploy stateful agents (using LangGraph) that plan tasks, query Knowledge Graphs, and execute tools without hallucinating.
    • Advanced RAG: Build Graph-RAG pipelines that combine semantic search with structured knowledge traversal for grounded answers
  • Graph & Knowledge Engineering
    • Knowledge Graph Engineering: Design domain ontologies in Neo4j, defining relationships between assets, documents, and time-series data.
    • Search Infrastructure: Implement Hybrid Retrieval logic combining Vector Search, Full-Text Search, and Graph traversal.

Qualifications

We use a modern, high-performance stack. You should be proficient in the Core and deeply knowledgeable in your chosen track.

  • Core Backend: Python 3.12+ (FastAPI, Pydantic), Polars, Docker, Kubernetes.
  • Streaming: Apache Kafka, Flink, Spark Streaming, TimescaleDB, Tiger Data.
  • GenAI: LangGraph, LangChain, LiteLLM, Azure OpenAI/Anthropic/Local SLMs.
  • Graph/Data: Neo4j (Cypher), PostgreSQL (pg_vector, Full-Text Search).

What We Do

Executive Search Senior Associates play a critical role in the execution of all facets of the executive recruiting lifecycle, from candidate identification to placement. Working closely with our expert Search Partners & Principals (Consultants), Senior Associates build upon their existing professional skills in a hands‑on environment and continue to receive world‑class mentorship and professional development in an apprenticeship‑style method. Our Senior Associates drive most aspects of the recruitment process, from developing the search strategy with the Consultant through managing its execution. Senior Associates also get exposure to business development activities. The search process includes working with clients to develop position specifications; interviewing, and assessing prospective candidates and building a pipeline of qualified candidates for active searches meeting the client’s requirements; developing the candidate relationship; and candidate referencing. An integral part of a Senior Associate’s role is assisting with client relationship management, sustaining relationships with senior executives and guiding candidates through their recruitment journey.

While learning the Search industry, Senior Associates invest significant time researching and learning about various industries, executive roles and functions, and do so in collaboration with colleagues across the globe. The Senior Associate role provides a great degree of visibility, significant responsibility and the opportunity for high impact with an excellent career track potential on a well‑defined path.

Research & Writing

  • Developing position specification(s) and creating an effective search strategy in tandem with the Consultant.

  • Assisting Consultants in preparing business development materials to present to prospective and current clients.

Internal and External Communication

  • Contacting prospective candidates to elicit interest in client opportunities, obtaining referrals, and/or collecting market intelligence and feedback.
  • Conducting in-depth interviews to assess candidate qualifications and fit to position specifications.
  • Writing candidate assessments and presenting candidates to clients.
  • Managing candidate relationships throughout the entire life cycle of the search and keeping the Consultant abreast of candidate updates.
  • Contributing to client relationship management with the Consultant.

Ethics & Quality

  • Maintaining the accuracy, quality, and integrity of all Search information in our various internal and external research tools.

  • Managing multiple concurrent projects and completing high quality deliverables on time.
  • Acting with the highest regard to professionalism, confidentiality, and ethics.
  • Succeeding and persisting through challenges, motivated to do the right thing.

Basic Role Qualifications

  • 4-6 years professional experience or a minimum of 3+ years of transferable recruiting experience.
  • An undergraduate BA/BS degree is required.
  • Exhibits skill and developing mastery of professional communications, displaying adeptness in writing, articulating, and delivering information with confidence and impact.
  • Exhibits a proven ability to collaborate with external clients and candidates, showcasing adeptness in influencing and fostering productive partnerships.

Preferred Role Qualifications

  • Prior experience in full life cycle recruiting in Executive Search, Contingent Search or In‑House Talent Acquisition or other industry requiring applied sales and research skills strongly preferred.
  • Proven success simultaneously managing multiple projects and working across teams.

We’re on the hunt for QAs for autonomous AI agents for a new project focused on validating and improving complex task structures, policy logic, and agent evaluation frameworks. Together, Carta is creating the end‑to‑end ERP platform for private markets. Traditional ERP solutions don’t work for Private Funds. Private capital markets need a comprehensive software solution to replace outdated spreadsheets and fragmented service providers. Carta’s software for the Office of the Fund CFO does just that - it’s a new category of software to make private markets look more like public markets - a connected ERP for private capital.

At Carta we create owners and make private markets liquid.

We live in a world where some people live on the equity stack and enjoy exponential wealth growth and preferential tax treatment; others live on the debt stack and may work their entire lives for a company and retire only with the cash they’ve managed to save from their paychecks. Our contribution to solving the wealth inequality problem is moving people from the debt stack (payroll) to the equity stack. By making it as easy to issue equity to employees as it is to put them on payroll, we can create more owners.

At Carta, we are helpful, transparent, fair, and kind. We are relentless executors, unconventional thinkers, and masters of our craft.

To learn more, here is what one of our investors wrote about leading our Series F.

The Company You’ll Join

Carta connects founders, investors, and limited partners through world-class software, purpose-built for everyone in venture capital, private equity and private credit. Trusted by 65,000+ companies in 160+ countries, Carta’s platform of software and services lays the groundwork so you can build, invest, and scale with confidence.

Carta’s Fund Administration platform supports 9,000+ funds and SPVs, representing nearly $185B in assets under management, with tools designed to enhance the strategic impact of fund CFOs. Recognized by Fortune, Forbes, Fast Company, Inc. and Great Places to Work, Carta is shaping the future of private market infrastructure.

Together, Carta is creating the end-to-end ERP platform for private markets. Traditional ERP solutions don’t work for Private Funds. Private capital markets need a comprehensive software solution to replace outdated spreadsheets and fragmented service providers. Carta’s software for the Office of the Fund CFO does just that - it’s a new category of software to make private markets look more like public markets - a connected ERP for private capital.

For more information about our offices and culture, check out our Carta careers page.

The Team You’ll Work With

The Data Ops team is focused on delivering high-quality, auditable data to our customers. You will work within a team dedicated to reducing customer effort and empowering clients to take actionable insights from their private markets data.

The Problems You’ll Solve

As a Data Ops Analyst, you will be responsible for the lifecycle of quarterly data extraction and client reporting. Your primary objective is to ensure that extracted data is high-quality, timely, and actionable for our customers.

Your core responsibilities will include:

  • Quarterly Data Extraction: Manage the extraction of private markets data from accounting documents and performance reports.

  • Customer Support: Provide timely and accurate front-line support for all customers that your segment services.
  • Active Engagement: Proactively follow up with clients during each quarterly data campaign, providing clear tracking of what data is complete and ready for client review.
  • Real-time Interaction: Engage with clients in real-time via phone or Zoom to resolve issues and guide them through their data.
  • Process Improvement: Keep detailed documentation of client interactions to identify trends and drive operational and process improvements for the data ops team and the product teams.
  • Project Management: Treat every data campaign as a project, ensuring all stakeholders are updated on progress and milestones.
  • Subject Matter Expertise: Become an expert in private markets data, including financial metrics and KPIs.

About You

  • Communication: Fluent in English with the ability to articulate technical and complex concepts in a clear and concise manner.
  • Analytical Skills: Knowledge of financial statements and common financial concepts with a strong sense of curiosity to solve problems.
  • Organization: Highly organized with strong attention to detail and the ability to balance multiple active projects with competing priorities.
  • Client Service: Care deeply and genuinely about client services; you exhibit diplomacy, tact, and poise under pressure.
  • Adaptability: Comfortable learning new technologies and platforms quickly in a fast-paced environment.

description:
The Company You’ll Join

Carta is a platform that helps people manage equity, build businesses, and invest in the companies of tomorrow. Our mission is to unlock the power of equity ownership for more people in more places.

Carta is trusted by more than 40,000 companies and over two million people in nearly 160 countries to manage cap tables, compensation, and valuations. Carta also supports nearly 7,000 funds and SPVs, and represents nearly $130B in assets under administration. Carta's tender offer solutions have returned $14B to shareholders in secondary transactions. Today, Carta’s platform manages nearly three trillion dollars in equity globally.

For more information about our offices and culture, check out our Carta careers page.

The Problems You’ll Solve

At Carta, our employees set out on a mission to unlock the power of equity ownership for more people in more places. We believe that the problems we solve today unlock the opportunities of tomorrow.

As an Implementations Accountant, you will focus efforts on supporting new Fund Administration customers in their journey into Carta services. You work within our fast-growing Fund Administration business by coordinating, facilitating and managing onboarding activities that are critical to achieving success for both our customers and Carta within a tight deadline. You will:

  • Liaise between Sales and Fund Accounting teams as the bridge post-sales for new fund clients
  • Interact with a fund’s back office (CFO, fund manager) to collect their historical accounting data, provide advisory support, and ultimately deliver accurate financial statements to both the client and internal stakeholders
  • Book and reconcile all accounting books and records from, at times, unstructured client data. This includes reproducing Capital Calls, Distributions, Expenses, Investments, Management Fees, Financial Statements, and Partners’ Capital to match client sources.
  • Resolving escalations related to data migration, historical accounting discrepancies, and client onboarding issues
  • Manage all aspects of customer onboarding for medium to high complexity new clients by managing timelines, setting clear customer expectations, and completing all compliance procedures pre go-live
  • Build strong client relationships and provide a white glove experience by going on-site, anticipating client needs, and using Carta app capabilities effectively
  • Identify process and quality improvements, assist with internal reviews, Quality Assurance, and train junior team members
  • Sharing accounting and onboarding specificities with upstream teams for efficient post go-live fund administration

The Team You\u2019ll Work With

Our implementation accounting team acts as the bridge between sales and long term account management for new fund clients. The team ensures whatever information our clients had before joining Carta is correctly migrated into our system. Ours is a team of folks who have mastery of accounting, exhibit a high degree of problem-solving, efficiency, and integrity as they leverage their subject-matter expertise to provide customers with a world-class onboarding experience.

About You

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or Finance, or equivalent experience
  • 5+ years of experience in an accounting role where you executed all aspects of end of quarter and year closes, preferably working within the Venture Capital Fund Administration environment
  • Strong accounting analysis skills with the ability to interpret a story through multiple years of unstructured data, and reproduce Financial Statements correctly
  • Ability to build strong client relationships through transparent and forthright communication. Able to manage multiple clients while hitting deadlines and providing white-glove service
  • Passionate about growing and advancing with Carta
  • Proven internal influencer having implemented and successfully managed both small and large projects or initiatives with sustained, measurable success
  • Incredible organizational skills, high attention to detail, and an ability to complete competing priorities quickly and autonomously

Salary

Carta’s compensation package includes a market competitive salary, equity for all full time roles, exceptional benefits, and, for applicable roles, commissions plans. Our minimum cash compensation (salary + commission if applicable) range for this role is:

  • $102,000 - $120,000 in San Francisco, CA, Santa Clara, CA, and New York, NY
  • $96,900 - $114,000 in Seattle, WA

We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to providing a positive interview experience for every candidate. If accommodations due to a disability or medical condition are needed, please connect with the recruiter via email. As a company, we value fairness, helpfulness, transparency, leadership and build our teams around these values. Check out our careers page to get to know us better as you think about your next step at Carta.

Important Security Notice for Candidates

Our company has been targeted by individuals creating fake domains similar to ours to scam prospects and candidates. Please note that all official communications from us will come from an @carta.com domain. Be cautious of any requests for sensitive information or payments outside of our official channels. For more information about this type of scam, please review the guidelines provided by the Federal Trade Commission (FTC). If you encounter any suspicious activity, please report it immediately to

Awards and Acknowledgements

Companies and funds like Tribe and Pipe build their businesses on Carta. The company has been included on the Forbes World’s Best Cloud Companies, Fast Company\u2019s Most Innovative list, and Inc.’s Fastest-Growing Private Companies. We’ve also been recognized as a 2023 Built In Best Place to Work in the U.S., a Muse VIBE Award winner in the Vacation and Time Off category and certified as a Great Place to Work.

Overview

Manager, Venue Technology role at FIFA Women\u2019s World Cup. FIFA27 will be established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the FIFA Women\u2019s World Cup 2027 (FWWC2027).

Department: Technology

Location: Brazil

Description

The Venue Technology Manager is responsible for supporting the Technology team with venue-specific technology deliverables for the FIFA Women\u2019s World Cup 2027 TM (FWWC 2027) within Brazil. The role entails coordinating with all relevant parties to plan, implement, ensure readiness, and operate all Event Technology services pertinent to the tournament and associated events within Brazil.

Responsibilities

  • Ensure all aspects of Technology, Telecommunications and Broadcast Technology Services are implemented in accordance with pre-agreed FIFA Technology requirements at the assigned venue(s).

  • Collaborate with stakeholders, clients, providers, and government entities to deliver technology services across all venues according to the defined governance structure.
  • Contribute to the venue technology working groups across planning, implementation, readiness and operations.
  • Manage technology demand/needs for technology services across the tournament space (Technology Equipment Allocation Process).

  • Ensure information pertaining to infrastructure, services and spaces needed for delivery and support of technology services is communicated to venue/site authorities and delivery teams.
  • Provide guidance on venue build-out and technology services implementation, including commissioning and decommissioning of tournament venues.
  • Collaborate with assigned personnel and Stadium partners to enable/support timely delivery of venue technology services.
  • Develop regular progress, risk and issue management reports in accordance with governance structures and PMO systems.
  • Manage on-site IT Technicians and support teams during tournament operations, including end-of-day reporting and incident escalation to IT Command Centre.

Your profile

  • University degree or equivalent in Information Technology, Computer Science or related field
  • Minimum of 8 years IT experience and at least 4 years in a similar role
  • Experience in the Sports/major event industry is required
  • Proven track record of delivering complex IT programs and projects
  • Experience managing teams in similar projects
  • Knowledge of venue technology services across major sporting events
  • Up-to-date knowledge of event-related technologies, including CATV, radio communications, wired communications, printing, broadcast contribution network, spectrum, audio and visual
  • Strong professional demeanor and cross-group collaboration skills
  • Ability to lead virtual teams, manage conflicts, and drive consensus to meet milestones
  • Leadership and ability to motivate team members
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and facilitation skills
  • Ability to adapt communication to diverse audiences
  • Leadership and accountability across relevant areas
  • Strong political acumen and adaptability to various working environments
  • Right to work in Brazil
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written) and Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Proficiency in additional FIFA languages (FR/ES/GER) is an asset
  • Willingness to travel within Brazil (up to 20%), with some longer trips (15 days or more)
  • Ability to relocate to Rio de Janeiro

Details

  • Seniority level: Mid-Senior level
  • Employment type: Contract
  • Job function: Engineering and Information Technology

title: Product Manager Sr
description:
Descrição da vaga

Visão: Ser a ponte entre as necessidades dos clientes e a estratégia de negócio, transformando ideias e oportunidades em produtos inovadores, intuitivos e valiosos que encantem os usuários e impulsionem o crescimento da empresa.

Missão: Liderar o ciclo de vida completo do produto, desde a descoberta de oportunidades até a entrega e iteração contínua, garantindo que a equipe construa o produto certo, para o público certo, e que ele gere o impacto esperado.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Definir e evoluir a visão da aplicação do produto, garantindo clareza, usabilidade e alinhamento com os objetivos do negócio;
  • Atuar como responsável pelo backlog do produto, priorizando funcionalidades com base em valor, impacto e dependências técnicas;
  • Traduzir necessidades do negócio em requisitos funcionais e experiências de uso claras, em parceria com UX e tecnologia;
  • Orquestrar a integração do front com serviços de cálculo e regras via APIs, assegurando consistência e confiabilidade da experiência;
  • Trabalhar de forma próxima com times de tecnologia, UX, dados e stakeholders comerciais;
  • Conduzir ciclos de validação, testes controlados e releases graduais, começando por públicos restritos;
  • Definir e acompanhar métricas de uso, eficiência e qualidade da experiência;
  • Garantir padrões de experiência, performance, segurança e governança do produto;
  • Comunicar evolução, riscos e marcos do produto de forma clara para liderança;
  • Investigar profundamente os problemas e as necessidades dos usuários por meio de pesquisas, entrevistas e análise de dados para identificar oportunidades de alto valor;
  • Construir e comunicar uma visão de produto clara, uma estratégia coesa e um roadmap priorizado que alinhe stakeholders, lideranças e a equipe de desenvolvimento em torno de objetivos comuns;
  • Colaborar de perto com as demais áreas para garantir a entrega de soluções de alta qualidade de forma ágil, removendo impedimentos e garantindo o foco no valor;
  • Definir métricas de sucesso, analisar o impacto das entregas e usar os aprendizados para guiar a evolução contínua do produto, otimizando a experiência do usuário e os resultados de negócio.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Experiência como Product Manager ou função similar em produtos digitais;
  • Vivência em desenvolvimento de front-end integrado a APIs/microserviços;
  • Capacidade de estruturar produtos em ambientes complexos e regulados;
  • Experiência com métodos ágeis e gestão de backlog;
  • Boa capacidade de comunicação e articulação entre áreas técnicas e de negócio;
  • Graduação em Administração, Sistemas de Informação, Ciência da Computação ou áreas correlatas.

Desejável:

  • Pós-graduação ou MBA em Gestão de Produtos, Negócios, Tecnologia, Dados ou Estratégia;
  • Certificações em Product Management, Métodos Ágeis ou UX (CSPO, PSPO, PMI-ACP, etc.)

Diferenciais

  • Experiência em plataformas B2B ou sistemas comerciais;
  • Atuação em produtos com regras de negócio complexas;
  • Vivência com UX para ferramentas internas ou produtos de decisão;
  • Experiência em ambientes corporativos de grande escala;
  • Experiência com testes de preço (A/B testing): Ter conduzido experimentos para validar diferentes faixas de preço ou modelos;
  • Experiência com estratégias de precificação: Ter atuado em projetos de definição e estratégia de preços.

Competências Técnicas:

  • Definição de visão, estratégia e roadmap de produto. o Priorização de backlog baseada em valor, impacto e esforço.
  • Gestão do ciclo de vida do produto (ideação, discovery, delivery, evolução e sunset).
  • Condução de entrevistas com usuários e stakeholders.
  • Validação de hipóteses com MVPs, protótipos e testes.
  • Uso de métodos como Design Thinking, Lean, Jobs To Be Done.
  • Definição e acompanhamento de métricas de produto (OKRs, KPIs, North Star Metric).
  • Análise de dados para tomada de decisão.
  • Noções de experimentação, testes A/B e métricas de impacto.
  • Entendimento de modelo de negócio, proposta de valor e posicionamento.
  • Análise de mercado, concorrência e tendências.
  • Avaliação de ROI, custo, valor e trade-offs estratégicos.
  • Capacidade de dialogar com engenharia, entendendo arquitetura, APIs, integrações e limitações técnicas.
  • Noções de dados, analytics e plataformas digitais.
  • Uso de ferramentas de gestão (Jira, Confluence, Notion, Miro, Figma, etc.).
  • Colaboração com UX/UI na definição de fluxos e protótipos.
  • Garantia de usabilidade, acessibilidade e experiência consistente

Competências Comportamentais:

  • Pensar o produto no longo prazo, alinhado à estratégia da empresa.
  • Conectar decisões táticas à visão macro.
  • Comunicar visão, prioridades e decisões com clareza.
  • Influenciar sem autoridade formal, alinhando múltiplos interesses.
  • Entender profundamente usuários, clientes e stakeholders.
  • Escutar ativamente e traduzir necessidades em soluções.
  • Decidir com base em dados, contexto e julgamento.
  • Assumir responsabilidade por escolhas e resultados.
  • Trabalhar de forma próxima com tecnologia, design, negócio e operações.
  • Facilitar alinhamentos e resolver conflitos de forma construtiva.
  • Lidar bem com mudanças, incertezas e aprendizado contínuo.
  • Ajustar estratégias conforme feedback e dados.
  • Ter senso de dono(a) do produto.

Informações adicionais

E tem mais, confira o nosso pacote de benefícios:

  • Plano de Saúde e Odontológico – Bradesco – extensivo a dependentes
  • PAE - Auxílio financeiro oferecido no caso de dependentes filhos(as) e/ou enteados(as) com deficiência intelectual

title: Analista de Suporte N2 – Redes
description:
Sobre a empresa

Somos um provedor de internet em crescimento, focado em qualidade, estabilidade e atendimento próximo aos nossos clientes.
Buscamos um Analista N2 Pleno para cuidar da parte técnica da rede e apoiar a expansão da empresa.

Missão do cargo

Garantir que a rede funcione de forma estável , resolvendo problemas técnicos de clientes e da infraestrutura, atuando entre o atendimento N1 e a engenharia/N3 .

Atividades principais

  • Atender chamados escalados pelo N1 (casos que o N1 não conseguiu resolver).
  • Analisar conectividade :
    • Testes de ping e traceroute (IP e domínio).
    • Identificar se o problema está no cliente, na rede interna, no POP, na rota ou na operadora.
  • Acessar e analisar OLT GPON (ZTE, Huawei, Fiberhome, Nokia ou similar):
    • Ver potência RX/TX das ONUs.
    • Ver ONUs flutuando (online/offline).
    • Verificar erros e utilização das portas GPON.
  • Verificar e ajustar VLAN, PPPoE, IPoE e DHCP :
    • Sessões PPPoE travadas.
    • Cliente autenticando e não navegando.
    • Cliente sem IP ou recebendo IP incorreto.
  • Apoiar o time de campo com diagnóstico técnico (indicar provável ponto de falha).
  • Utilizar ferramentas de monitoramento (Zabbix, Grafana ou similares) para identificar e prevenir instabilidades.
  • Registrar nos chamados o passo a passo do diagnóstico e da solução .

Requisitos técnicos (obrigatórios)

  • Experiência prévia em provedor de internet ou suporte de redes .
  • Bom conhecimento de TCP/IP (IP, máscara, gateway, DNS, rota).
  • Entender bem PPPoE e/ou IPoE .
  • Saber trabalhar com VLAN (ACCESS/TRUNK, tagged/untagged).
  • Noções sólidas de IPv4 e NAT.
  • Uso prático de ping , tracert/traceroute e testes por IP e domínio.
  • Conhecimento básico em ao menos um equipamento de borda, por exemplo: Mikrotik, Cisco, Huawei ou similar .
  • Capacidade de leitura e interpretação de logs (roteador, OLT, servidor PPPoE/DHCP).

Diferenciais (não obrigatórios, mas contam ponto)

  • Experiência com OLT GPON (ZTE, Huawei, Fiberhome, Nokia, etc.).
  • Conhecimento de CGNAT / BNG / BRAS .

title: Static Mechanical Engineer - Relocate to Saudi Arabia, Permanent Expat Relocation Package
description:
Static Mechanical Engineer - Relocate to Saudi Arabia, Permanent Expat Relocation Package

Full relocation to Saudi Arabia – permanent full-time Expat Relocation Package.

Job Overview: We are seeking a Plant Corrosion Engineer to join the Riyas Engineering Division (RNGLFD) which is part of the Riyas NGL Fractionation Dept (RNGLFD).

RNGLFD is responsible for two trains, each designed to process 255 MBOD (242.25 MBCD). Each train will include fractionation units, C3 & C4 treatment, C3 & C4 dehydration and propane refrigeration. The common facilities will include feed and product surge storage, chemicals storage and utilities including, but not limited to, steam and condensate recovery systems, utility water, plant, instrument air and nitrogen systems, machinery cooling water, drainage and flare systems. Some of the systems (e.g., steam headers, flare headers, product storage) have been pre-invested for the future train.

Your primary role will be to implement, support and continually improve RNGLFP inspection corrosion management programs and provide consolatory advice in materials, ensuring cost effective material selection and corrosion mitigation strategies, which will ensure mechanical integrity of the materials, applied on all plant assets including equipment and piping through their life cycle.

Key Responsibilities

  • Implement corrosion management program and on-stream monitoring and Conduct risk-based inspection based on API-580 methodology.
  • Review and approve recommended solutions for coating failures and cathodic protection and participate in HAZOP review sessions and ensure that all issues are addressed.
  • Manage water treatment program and recommend solutions to overcome challenges and review design packages and validate materials selection based on current code and standards.
  • Validate corrosion controls corrosion controls, corrosion (CCD), corrosion loops and corrosion damage mechanisms frequently.
  • Assess FEED composition changes and approve recommended solution to assure assets integrity.
  • Develop scope and description of technology items, and lead field implementation.
  • Develop and transfer knowledge about use of coating, Cathodic protection (CP), corrosion inhibitors and other corrosion controls and best practices.
  • Extract data and draw conclusions from Corrosion Monitoring Technologies, and troubleshoot corrosion problems and address root causes.
  • Perform the regular review and update on the plants Integrity Operating Windows (IOW) and Corrosion loops drawings shall be updated by adding emerging damage mechanisms or removing damage mechanisms because of plant upgrades.
  • Adjust and modify inspection practices and programs shall be reflected based on such modifications and perform special studies in corrosion control. Evaluates data as to scope, impact and long-range cost effectiveness on existing and new projects.
  • Review operations and monitoring activities to identify needed system modifications or procedural changes associated with corrosion control with conduct corrosion mitigation and integrity review to optimize the inspection and corrosion programs and maintain assets integrity.

Qualification Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in engineering, preferably in mechanical engineer.
  • 15 years' experience processing in Oil/Gas Industry.
  • Demonstrate experience in material science and metrology, different NDT technology and their applications and knowledge in engineering aspect of welding.
  • Strong Knowledge of international standards and codes NACE, ASME, API and ASTM especially inspection and corrosion standards such as API-571, API-580, API-570 and API-510.
  • Valid NACE Specialist Certification or NACE Senior Corrosion Technologist or combination of NACE Corrosion Technologist, API-571 and NACE CP level II.

Para obter mais informações, visite .

Coordenar as atividades do setor de logística, distribuir e orientar os serviços do Almoxarifado e Revenda, abrangendo o recebimento e armazenamento de peças nacionais e importadas, garantindo a acuracidade do estoque e os devidos registros de movimentações, acompanhar as atividades de expedição de peças e produtos acabados para o mercado interno e exportação, controlar todo o fluxo do processo de armazenagem dos armazéns internos e externos, coordenar as atividades de separação, embalagem e envio de peças e produtos de automação e intercompany, e processos de reparos eletrônicos com o objetivo de garantir a reposição de peças em campo e buscar soluções para eventuais problemas que possam ocorrer.

Responsabilidades definidas para o Encarregado do setor de almoxarifado:

  • Supervisionar a contagem cíclica e acompanhar as devidas análises bem como, tratativas das divergências quando necessário.
  • Gerir a equipe em todos os processos de desenvolvimento, treinamento de procedimentos/instruções de trabalho, assim como realizar manutenção de apontamento de ponto, programação de férias via sistema de Administração de Pessoal;
  • Prezar pelas condições de segurança de sua equipe no seu âmbito de atuação, atendendo aos requisitos legais da empresa, acompanhando uso e validade dos equipamentos, visando garantir o cumprimento de normas e exigências legais e da empresa;
  • Acompanhar as rotinas de recebimento e programar junto ao time de compras os recebimentos diários, a fim de adequar a capacidade de recebimento a demanda;
  • Garantir a gestão do fluxo de recebimento e armazenamento de materiais, garantindo acuracidade da conferência, movimentação física e sistêmica dos itens recebidos, e eliminar divergências de estoque e ajustes financeiros desnecessários;
  • Analisar junto ao time de Sourcing e Qualidade o melhor tipo de embalagem para os produtos recebidos a fim de garantir o melhor uso de espaço do armazém, facilitando assim a conferência, armazenagem e garantindo a conservação do produto durante o transporte e no armazém;
  • Informar diariamente a diretoria, área de vendas, suporte a cliente, planejamento de materiais, produção e setores envolvidos sobre o nível de estoque de produto acabado e solicitar / controlar Ordens de Pagamentos (POs) referentes aos pagamentos de fornecedores de fretes;
  • Participar de reuniões com a área de planejamento referente a programação de produção dos pedidos de revenda e monitorar estoque/itens em almoxarifado de peças fora de linha;
  • Garantir a continuidade do programa 5S, ou similar, nas áreas sob sua responsabilidade;
  • Executar outras tarefas correlatas a critério do superior imediato.

Responsabilidades definidas para o Encarregado do setor de Revenda

  • Gerir a equipe em todos os processos de desenvolvimento, treinamento de procedimentos/instruções de trabalho, assim como realizar manutenção de apontamento de ponto, programação de férias via sistema de Administração de Pessoal;
  • Prezar pelas condições de segurança de sua equipe no seu âmbito de atuação, atendendo aos requisitos legais da empresa, acompanhando uso e validade dos equipamentos, visando garantir o cumprimento de normas e exigências legais e da empresa;
  • Identificar necessidades prioritárias de expedição de produtos acabados, coordenar a movimentação, armazenamento e organização dos materiais a serem expedidos, e coordenar todo o fluxo de saldos de produtos acabados internamente e em armazéns externos.
  • Realizar interface / acompanhamento, controles e negociações de prazos com empresas de transporte/correios, bem como elaborar indicador de desempenho de performance de transportadoras;
  • Informar diariamente a diretoria, área de vendas, suporte a cliente, planejamento de materiais, produção e setores envolvidos sobre o nível de estoque de produto acabado e solicitar / controlar Ordens de Pagamentos (POs) referentes aos pagamentos de fornecedores de fretes;
  • Acompanhar entrada de pedidos de revenda, automação e pedidos intercompany, garantindo o atendimento aos prazos estabelecidos, bem como controlar a base de dados e todas as informações pertinentes aos processos de expedição e logística reversa;
  • Garantir a continuidade do programa 5S, ou similar, nas áreas sob sua responsabilidade;
  • Executar outras tarefas correlatas a critério do superior imediato.

Conhecimentos especificos / Habilidades:

  • Conhecimentos em ERP (preferência Oracle);
  • Conhecimentos em Excel (preferência Avançado);
  • Conhecimentos em Armazenagem e Frete;
  • Habilidade de comunicação / Liderança, Planejamento e relacionamento Interpessoal.

Qualificações básicas / formação:

Ensino Médio completo ou Superior Completo em Administração, Engenharia Produção, logística ou afins.

title: Partnership Development Manager FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027TM
description:
Overview

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

The position

The Partnership Development Manager will be responsible for driving sponsorship sales and strategic partnerships for the FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™, with a strong focus on the Brazilian and LATAM markets. The role requires deep market knowledge and a robust network in the region.

Key responsibilities

  • Work closely with the Senior Partnership Development Manager, FIFA Women’s World Cup Sales Lead and the broader commercial team to deliver on sponsorship sales objectives for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™, with a strong emphasis on the Brazilian and LATAM markets.
  • Identify and pursue high-value sponsorship leads aligned with the commercial strategy of the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™.
  • Source, qualify, and engage potential sponsors, securing meetings and presenting tailored partnership proposals to major regional and international brands.
  • Develop bespoke sponsorship packages that address the unique needs and objectives of prospective partners.
  • Lead negotiations through to successful acquisition, ensuring alignment with FIFA’s commercial guidelines and values.
  • Collaborate with the Strategy and Planning team to identify market opportunities and build compelling sales arguments.
  • Establish and nurture long-term relationships with key sponsor prospects, ensuring continuity and value beyond the tournament.
  • Serve as a key point of contact for the FIFA27 team in Brazil on sales-related matters, supporting or managing the sales process as needed.
  • Stay informed on emerging sponsorship categories, regional industry trends, and relevant market research, including pricing and inventory benchmarks.
  • Build strong external visibility for FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ commercial opportunities, fostering inbound interest and leads through proactive industry engagement.
  • Lead and support the organisation of commercial events, conferences, hosting programmes, dedicated to cultivating business relationships and building into the sales pipeline.

Your profile

  • Highly professional, articulate and results-driven.
  • Strong presenter and excellent relationship building skills.
  • Proven experience in sponsorship sales, business development, or commercial partnerships, preferably in sports or entertainment.
  • Strong network and understanding of the Brazilian and LATAM commercial landscape.
  • Experience in dealing with and negotiating within different cultures.
  • Ability to work independently in a multi-task position within a dynamic, team-based environment.
  • Solutions orientated.
  • Solid time management and organizational skills.
  • Client oriented, efficient and effective.
  • Adept at handling and protecting confidential information.
  • Excellent team player and relationship builder.
  • Attention to detail, reliable and responsible.
  • An appreciation of the international sports federation environment, passion for women’s sports and global events.
  • University degree in business, sports marketing or related area
  • Excellent in Word / PowerPoint / Excel / PDF / MS Teams / Sales CRM tools
  • Ability to travel often and when required.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Any other FIFA language (Spanish especially) is an advantage
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

About FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027

The FIFA Women’s World Cup™ is the greatest women’s sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women’s football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we’re looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

description:
Job description

A Voltz é a fintech do Grupo Energisa.

Somos um hub de produtos financeiros escaláveis e geradores de valor nos ecossistemas de serviços básicos.

Começamos com a oferta de serviços digitais para pessoas físicas e expandimos nossa atuação para meios de pagamento e soluções para gestão financeira.

Além disso, oferecemos possibilidades de negociação para consumidores de serviços essenciais e crédito para fornecedores.

Main responsibilities

O dia a dia:

  • Mapear e automatizar processos nas áreas de Vendas, Sucesso do Cliente e Operações , implementando soluções em ferramentas como Pipefy, RD Station ou similares para garantir eficiência e padronização.
  • Apoiar e otimizar os fluxos de geração, qualificação e repasse de leads , assegurando agilidade e qualidade na entrega ao time comercial.
  • Gerir e formalizar propostas, inserções e contratos , garantindo rastreabilidade, agilidade e conformidade.
  • Construir e monitorar indicadores de performance (KPIs) , históricos de dados e painéis de acompanhamento , utilizando ferramentas de BI como Power BI ou Looker .
  • Identificar gargalos operacionais e oportunidades de melhoria contínua ao longo de toda a jornada do cliente.
  • Criar e aplicar controles e checkpoints em processos comerciais, incluindo exceções e interações manuais, assegurando qualidade e eficiência.
  • Manter alinhamento estratégico com áreas como Produto, Dados, UX, Marketing, Crédito e Tecnologia, garantindo coerência nas iniciativas e processos.
  • Participar do desenho e aprimoramento do pitch de vendas , definição de públicos-alvo e estratégias de segmentação para campanhas de aquisição e ativação de clientes.
  • Atuar no apoio à pré-venda , organizando fluxos e ferramentas de CRM para elevar a qualidade dos leads e otimizar processos de qualificação.
  • Apoiar a gestão de processos de pós-venda e suporte , promovendo melhorias contínuas e redução de gargalos operacionais.

Requirements and skills

Para essa posição, esperamos que você tenha:

  • Experiência em Planejamento Comercial , Operações de Vendas ou Produtos Financeiros .
  • Perfil fortemente Data Driven , com domínio de métricas, KPIs e análise de performance.
  • Conhecimento avançado em Visão Sistêmica : compreender como cada parte do negócio se conecta e impacta o todo.
  • Foco em Resultados : orientação clara para o cumprimento de metas e objetivos estratégicos da empresa.
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de automação (ex.: N8N ou similares) e CRM (ex.: RD Station, Pipefy, Salesforce).
  • Habilidade em mapeamento e melhoria de processos (BPM, SIPOC, 5W2H etc).
  • Conhecimentos em ferramentas de BI (Power BI, Looker ou similares).
  • Desejável familiaridade com produtos financeiros como crédito, antecipação de recebíveis, faturas e seguros.

Sabemos que carreiras podem ser tão diferentes quanto as próprias pessoas. Por isso, na EY, você terá a liberdade, as ferramentas e as condições para se desenvolver e construir uma carreira tão única quanto você.

Oportunidade disponível para atuação híbrida no escritório do Rio de Janeiro.

Qual será o seu papel nesse propósito?

Como uma pessoa assessora sênior de impostos diretos, você será parte de Tax atuando em vários projetos globais e locais na área de Global Compliance and Reporting (GCR), ajudando grandes empresas a administrar e reduzir os riscos de suas operações, e assumindo as seguintes responsabilidades:

  • Auxiliar as equipes de auditoria na revisão dos cálculos e identificação de riscos / exposições;
  • Atuar na revisão e preparação da ECF (Escrituração Contábil Fiscal) e ECD (Escrituração Contábil Digital);

  • Desenvolver constantemente a sua compreensão das tendências e processos atuais do mercado e compartilhar o seu conhecimento para desenvolver a equipe;
  • Auxiliar as equipes de auditoria na revisão dos cálculos e identificação de riscos / exposições;
  • Realizar a revisão e preparação do imposto diferido e respectivas projeções de acordo com as normas ASC 740 e IAS 12, bem como Tax Provision e reconciliação da alíquota efetiva;
  • Atuar como especialista em várias equipes de atendimento ao cliente, participando de projetos na área de Business Tax Advisory;
  • Prestar consultoria na gestão de riscos e oportunidades que envolvam apuração de tributos diretos.

Se você possui os requisitos abaixo, essa oportunidade pode ser sua:

  • Experiência consistente em projetos que envolvam apuração de impostos diretos, desenvolvendo estratégias de planejamento tributário alinhadas às necessidades globais de cada cliente;
  • Profundo conhecimento em impostos diretos (IRPJ e CSLL – Lucro real e lucro resumindo) e na preparação/revisão de ECF e ECD;
  • Graduação em Administração, Direito ou Contabilidade.

Poderá ser um diferencial, caso você tenha os seguintes requisitos:

  • Excel - intermedirário/avançado;

O que oferecemos: Vale Alimentação, Vale Refeição, Vale Transporte, Plano de saúde, Assistência odontológica, Universidade Corporativa e outros benefícios Educacionais, Gympass, PLR, e muito mais.

Com presença em mais de 150 países, aqui você terá a oportunidade de viver as experiências excepcionais que só a EY pode oferecer, com alcance global, cultura inclusiva e tecnologia para se tornar a sua melhor versão.

A hora de fazer parte de um time comprometido, acolhedor e que leva saúde para milhões de pessoas, é agora!

Estamos na busca de profissionais para compor a nossa equipe!

Se você é comprometido(a) e apaixonado(a) por novos desafios, aqui é o seu lugar!

Faça seu cadastro e envie seu currículo!

  • Receber e passar o plantão, conhecendo e informando sobre todas as ocorrências, a fim de garantir a continuidade do cuidado prescrito ao paciente;
  • Passar visita à todos os pacientes, e acompanhar a execução da assistência de enfermagem, principalmente, junto àqueles de maior gravidade;
  • Garantir a realização de todas as etapas da SAE - Sistematização de Assistência de Enfermagem, bem como a execução de todas as ferramentas de qualidade assistencial do nosso cliente;
  • Garantir ações de acolhimento e clima organizacional, tanto aos pacientes quanto a sua equipe e a adesão da mesma em todas as políticas e protocolos institucionais;
  • Planejar, organizar, executar e avaliar a assistência de enfermagem em horário integral;
  • Garantir o cumprimento das normas institucionais por parte de sua equipe, através dos protocolos e políticas da Unidade;
  • Revisar os prontuários dos pacientes cirúrgicos e os preparos executados;
  • Zelar pela estrutura física sob sua responsabilidade, envolvendo a equipe neste objetivo, bem como auxiliar a Coordenação de Enfermagem no controle e conservação dos equipamentos da unidade;
  • Verificar a requisição de roupas e estoque mínimo de materiais e medicamentos;
  • Supervisionar as atividades de toda a equipe de enfermagem para garantir que as tarefas do período sejam executadas na sua totalidade;
  • Notificar a Supervisão ou Coordenação de Enfermagem todas as intercorrências do setor;
  • Distribuir tarefas de forma condizente com as funções exercidas pelos colaboradores, considerando os aspectos de desenvolvimento profissional e aspectos legais envolvidos na distribuição e execução de tarefas pelos subordinados;
  • Participar e colaborar com o setor de Educação Continuada na elaboração do programa de reciclagem conforme necessidades levantadas, visando colaborar com a garantia do desenvolvimento de sua equipe no aprimoramento profissional;
  • Participar de reuniões com a Gerência de Enfermagem, sempre que solicitado;
  • Controlar os psicotrópicos da unidade, bem como conferir e repor o carro de emergência, conforme rotina apresentada na Unidade e POP (procedimento operacional padrão) corporativo;
  • Realizar notificações compulsórias de acordo com as orientações da vigilância sanitária que estarão disponíveis com o SCIH - Serviço de Controle de Infecção Hospitalar de sua Unidade;
  • Realizar notificações de ocorrência e eventos, conforme formulário de notificação de eventos disponível em rede ou OnDrive;
  • Disseminar a cultura do programa de segurança ao paciente, conforme diretriz da Política de Segurança do Paciente disponível na Unidade Hospitalar em rede ou OnDrive;
  • Garantir a assistência de enfermagem livre de danos e assistência humanizada:
  • Cumprir determinações do CCIH – Centro de Controle de Infecção Hospitalar e segurança ocupacional, conforme os treinamentos e políticas adotadas e executadas por estas áreas;
  • Realizar contato com pacientes pré-atendimento e pós-atendimento, sempre que necessário e conforme diretriz institucional;
  • Orientar pacientes na alta médica com autorização para a saída do hospital com relação a cuidados e eventuais prescrição médica concedida após o período de internação;
  • Colaborar e participar de programas de treinamento e educação continuada e identificar necessidade de capacitação para os Técnicos e Auxiliares de Enfermagem, mantendo treinamento contínuo com implantação de normas, rotinas e procedimentos posteriormente aos programas realizados;
  • Para o exercício do cargo de Enfermeiro é imprescindível que o ocupante do cargo tenha registro vigente no Conselho Regional de Enfermagem (COREN), além de estar com as obrigações financeiras plenamente quitadas no referido conselho;
  • Executar outras atividades correlatas a critério do superior;
  • Controlar os materiais e medicamentos necessários ao atendimento.
  • Prestar os cuidados de enfermagem aos pacientes, verificar sinais vitais, atualizar e prover os registros, realizar procedimentos de enfermagem, prestar assistência de enfermagem aos pacientes dentro da unidade e auxiliar o médico.
  • Organizar o ambiente de trabalho, realizar ações de assistência de enfermagem, apoiar a equipe para acolher os procedimentos e cuidados necessários.
  • Ensino superior completo em Enfermagem ;
  • Pós-graduação nível especialização em UTI NEONATAL ;
  • COREN ativ o em Enfermeiro;
  • Experiência em UTI NEONATAL ;

Unidade:

  • Hospital Jacarepaguá | Estrada dos Três Rios, 542 - Freguesia de Jacarepaguá | Rio de Janeiro (RJ)

O que oferecemos?

  • Vale Alimentação;
  • Refeição no local;
  • Assistência Médica;
  • Assistência Odontológica;
  • Auxílio Creche;
  • Universidade Corporativa;

Há 80 anos, oferecemos o melhor para cumprir a nossa missão de proporcionar saúde integrada de qualidade e acessível a gerações de brasileiros. Cuidamos com qualidade do bem-estar das pessoas de forma séria, comprometida e socialmente responsável, somando as melhores práticas para oferecer saúde acessível e de qualidade à população brasileira.

Temos o compromisso de promover a diversidade e a inclusão no local de trabalho. Nossos objetivos são pautados na construção de um ambiente livre de preconceitos, discriminação, assédio moral e sexual, desrespeito, injustiça ou condutas ofensivas. Além disso, buscamos criar um ambiente onde todos se sintam seguros para expressar quem realmente são, com igualdade e equidade de oportunidades.

Incentivamos a candidatura de todas as pessoas que se sintam alinhadas ao nosso compromisso de diversidade e à nossa missão de tornar saúde de qualidade acessível aos brasileiros.
